mode: static PE read + capstone disassembly only; nothing executed; no repo file other than c-handlers/ written
scripts: handlers_recovery.py (asserts hash + every instruction/byte fact; writes handlers-recovery.facts.json)
handlers_locale.py (hash-gated frontend assets + clone locale; writes handlers-locale.json)
conventions: addresses are RVAs (image base 0x140000000) as in tools/lwbridge317/home009_native.py; state vocabulary per AGENTS.md section 4; confidence HIGH = instruction-level, MEDIUM = reconstructed control flow, LOW = deduction

1.title: set_automation (0x12c34b-0x12da36)

facts.fact: Before anything else the profile runtime is resolved from payload.profileId (payload must be an Object, profileId a String, length>0, no trimming). Errors: PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED (0x84158e, len 19, code==message), STATE_UNAVAILABLE (registry lock poisoned), PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE (0x841a25, len 27, no runtime for that id).

name = payload.get('name') if it is a JSON string else the empty string. enabled = payload.get('enabled') only if it is a JSON bool, otherwise false. There is NO payload type error: INVALID_PAYLOAD / AUTOMATION_* do not exist anywhere in the image.

Two names are handled by the host: 'autoClosePopup' (len 14) and 'autoForceUpdateReload' (len 21) (case-sensitive byte compare). For autoClosePopup the effective enabled is forced to false (xor ecx,ecx at 0x12d080 before the common store at 0x12d089); for autoForceUpdateReload the requested bool is used.

Persistence of local names: config.json (profile runtime directory) root object gets auto_force_update_reload / auto_close_popup = Bool(effective enabled), file rewritten atomically (tmp+commit). Errors: STATE_UNAVAILABLE 'config state is unavailable' (lock), INVALID_CONFIG 'object required' (root not an object), write errors propagated. Persist happens before any game interaction and is NOT rolled back.

facts.confidence: HIGH (calls, log text) / MEDIUM (observation-reset and republish semantics)
facts.fact: autoForceUpdateReload additionally calls 0x41a681(runtime, effective enabled): enabled -> run the recovery monitor tick (0x41a8a0) immediately; disabled -> reset monitor observation state, log 'game recovery stopped because automation is disabled' (0xd67e28), republish recovery status (0x41a850). The monitor and the recovery run re-read persisted auto_force_update_reload (0x41b7ef).

Local names, then: if the game is bridge-connected, request 'setAutomation' {name, enabled=effective} with timeout 5000 ms (0x1388). A game-side failure is logged (warn) and ignored; offline game skips the forward. Response is always Object{ok:true,name,enabled=effective}.

Any other name (including '') is NOT validated by the host: require connected game first (else GAME_DISCONNECTED, message 'game disconnected'), forward 'setAutomation' {name, enabled=requested} (5000 ms). A game error object is returned unchanged. After a game OK the host persists to config.json: autoShield->auto_shield, autoAttackShield->auto_attack_shield, autoWeekendShield->auto_weekend_shield, autoRedPacketTreasure->auto_red_packet_treasure; every other name only recomputes legacy auto_shield = auto_weekend_shield || auto_attack_shield (0x2cd431). Return Object{ok:true,name,enabled=requested}. A persist failure after a game OK is returned as an error (no rollback of the game side).

UI sends set_automation {profileId,name,enabled}; Home flags read automation_status.config.{auto_force_update_reload,auto_close_popup,auto_weekend_shield,auto_attack_shield}; the switch value after a write is response.enabled.

differences: RequireOptionalProfile lets a missing profileId through (original: PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED / PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE)
GetRequiredString/Boolean throw INVALID_PAYLOAD for missing/mis-typed name/enabled (original: '' and false, no error)
every name except autoForceUpdateReload throws AUTOMATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (original: autoClosePopup is a successful local no-enable; other names forward to the game with GAME_DISCONNECTED gate)
status config reports auto_weekend_shield/auto_attack_shield/auto_close_popup as constant false
clone.fix: SetAutomation: (1) require profileId via the shared resolver; (2) name=string-or-'' , enabled=bool-or-false, drop INVALID_PAYLOAD; (3) autoClosePopup: persist auto_close_popup=false, return {ok:true,name,enabled:false}; (4) autoForceUpdateReload: keep persist, then drive the recovery monitor (tick now when enabled; reset observation + republish when disabled); (5) other names: GAME_DISCONNECTED ('game disconnected') when not bridge-connected, otherwise forward through the current-client Lua path and only on success persist the 4 recovered keys; until that forward exists return a truthful incomplete error, not AUTOMATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED parity; (6) return {ok,name,enabled}; (7) add AutoClosePopup/AutoWeekendShield/AutoAttackShield/AutoRedPacketTreasure to LocalConfigStore and read them in CreateStatus.

differences: NotifyAutomationChanged is a no-op (original runs a monitor tick on enable and resets observation/republishes on disable)
clone.fix: enabled -> run RecoveryObservationAsync once; disabled -> reset the observation counters, log the original message, raise RecoveryStatusChanged; never cancel an in-flight run.

unknowns: Game-side setAutomation accepted names/value types/error codes (encrypted Lua; protected input).
Exact on-disk directory of config.json (path is [profile runtime state+0xa0]/config.json; mapping to the clone LocalConfigStore location is an adaptation).
Whether forcing autoClosePopup=false is deliberate product intent (behaviour itself is exact).

2.title: profile_select / profile_reorder / profile_note_set (0x10b70b, 0x12709b, 0x1a4d26; manager 0x326f21, 0x327460, 0x327c9b)

facts.fact: select: payload Object+String profileId else INVALID_REQUEST (code==message, 15 bytes) -> id valid ([0-9A-Za-z_-], 1..64 bytes) else INVALID_PROFILE_ID -> SELECT enabled=1 AND locked_reason IS NULL FROM profiles WHERE id=?: no row PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, value 0 PROFILE_LOCKED (both code==message) -> UPDATE controller_state SET value=? WHERE key='selected_profile_id'.

After the DB update, focusGame (JSON bool, missing or non-bool = true) triggers focus of that profile's game window if an instance exists (STATE_UNAVAILABLE on poisoned instance lock). Selection is already persisted at that point; there is no running-state check, no bridge-host-busy check and no rollback.

reorder: profileIds must be an array (INVALID_REQUEST otherwise); every id validated (INVALID_PROFILE_ID); then the list must have exactly the current profile count and contain every current id, else INVALID_PROFILE_ORDER; single transaction (begin/commit profile reorder), UPDATE profiles SET display_order=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=? with display_order = 0-based list index, updated_at = now ms. Lists are ordered display_order, created_at, id.

note_set: profileId then note strings; id validated FIRST (INVALID_PROFILE_ID); note rejected with INVALID_PROFILE_NOTE when it has more than 80 characters (count of non-continuation UTF-8 bytes) or any code point < 0x20 or 0x7f-0x9f; UPDATE profiles SET note=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?; 0 rows -> PROFILE_NOT_FOUND.

PROFILE_NOT_FOUND and PROFILE_LOCKED are original codes. BRIDGE_HOST_BUSY, GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS-on-select, GAME_REPAIR_REQUIRED, INSTANCE_NOT_OWNED are not (BRIDGE_HOST_BUSY, GAME_REPAIR_REQUIRED, INSTANCE_NOT_OWNED have count 0 in the image).

differences: profile_note_set does not call ValidateProfileId: (bad id, any note) gives PROFILE_NOT_FOUND / INVALID_PROFILE_NOTE instead of INVALID_PROFILE_ID
clone.fix: insert ValidateProfileId(profileId) between RequiredString(note) (line 97) and ValidateNote(note) (line 98).

differences: select/reorder SQL, error codes, 0-based display_order and permutation rule match; select-owner rollback (lines 74-92) is a clone mechanism
BRIDGE_HOST_BUSY / GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS / GAME_REPAIR_REQUIRED can reject a profile switch; the original never rejects profile_select for runtime reasons
clone.fix: A->A requires the switch to succeed whenever the profile exists and is enabled: make the runtime swap asynchronous/deferred behind the persisted selection instead of throwing; if that is impossible keep the fences but record them as clone-only incomplete behaviour (not parity).

unknowns: Error code for a non-string element inside profileIds (helper 0x3f6495, not decoded).
Result returned by profile_select/reorder/note_set handlers (profile-list serialization 0x253f44 inferred, MEDIUM).
Errors produced by the focus helper 0x2a2829.

3.title: game_root_select / game_root_status while a game runs (0x188f12-0x18a2ad, 0x413185)

facts.fact: game_root_select takes no payload (frontend calls game_root_select()); the folder comes from a native dialog. Dialog cancel returns an object with key 'canceled' (single l, built inline at 0x1893da) and persists nothing. The frontend shows INVALID_GAME_ROOT only when !canceled && !valid.

The chosen path is normalized, validated (Game\LastWar.exe layout) and stored; failure code INVALID_GAME_ROOT with message 'select the folder containing Game\LastWar.exe'. State write is under a write lock (poisoned -> STATE_UNAVAILABLE 'authorization state is unavailable').

Neither game_root_select nor game_root_status reaches any process API (Toolhelp, OpenProcess, TerminateProcess, EnumWindows, QueryFullProcessImageName). There is no GAME_RUNNING / GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS check: the original does not reject, stop or re-bind a running game on a root change; it just persists the new root.

Consequence (not executed): later consumers read the stored root (launch GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND 0x1d5be1; monitor find_game_pid(root) 0x41b451; unmanaged gate), so a running game under the old root is no longer found by the monitor under the new root.

differences: root selection throws GAME_OPERATION_CANCELLED (closed), GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS (starting/stopping/running/helper/recovery or uncertain launch attempt), GAME_REPAIR_REQUIRED (recovery journal) - none of these exist for game_root_select in the original; the original always persists a valid selection
clone.fix: accept and persist the selection even while an owned game runs; keep the owned instance bound to the root it was launched with (separate 'selected root' from 'owned instance root') so stop/restore and the recovery journal keep using the old root; only if the installation journal makes that impossible, document the fence as a clone-only incomplete behaviour.

unknowns: How the handler distinguishes an invalid pick returning valid:false (value built at 0x18972e through 0x2a19c3) from the Err path of 0x413185 - both carry INVALID_GAME_ROOT; field-level result schema not fully traced.
Live behaviour of a running game after a root change (needs live proof).

4.title: game_recovery_status (0x154905-0x155144)

facts.fact: Errors in order: PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED (payload not Object / profileId missing, non-string or empty; code==message), STATE_UNAVAILABLE (registry lock poisoned), PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE (no runtime for id), STATE_UNAVAILABLE 'game recovery state is unavailable' (recovery mutex poisoned). A freshly started or idle runtime is a normal result, never an error.
Result keys in serializer order: state, reason, updateDetected, restarted, startedAt, completedAt, attempts, nextRetryAt, error, noticeId, noticeVisible.

differences: whitespace-only profileId gives PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED (original: only the empty string; a blank id falls through to PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE)
statusProvider()==null gives STATE_UNAVAILABLE (original has no such case; LWBridgeBackend.cs:109-112 provider returns null when the lifecycle owner is absent)
clone.fix: use string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) at line ~46; when the provider is null return the idle record new OverviewRecoveryStatus("idle",null,false,false,0,null,0,null,null,0,false) (same as LWBridgeWindow.cs:5316) instead of throwing.

unknowns: Original registry-lock-poisoned wording (message equals code only for PROFILE_*; STATE_UNAVAILABLE message of 0x24156e not separately read).

5.title: Start in-flight / already-running / unmanaged precondition order

facts.fact: profile_instance_start (the command the UI uses) order: payload Object with String profileId else INVALID_REQUEST (closeUnmanaged bool default false) -> STATE_UNAVAILABLE (authorization state) -> GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND -> instance reservation 0x23e9dc: STATE_UNAVAILABLE | PROFILE_ALREADY_RUNNING (profile already has an instance record in ANY phase; a stale phase=='error' record whose flag byte is 0 is silently replaced) -> unmanaged-game gate (UNMANAGED_GAME_RUNNING{pids} unless closeUnmanaged; terminate errors; GAME_CLOSE_TIMEOUT after 5 s) -> PROFILE_LIMIT_REACHED -> ticket/lease/launch/bridge-wait stages.

GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS ('another game operation is already in progress') is the CAS try-acquire of ctx+0x115 and is taken only by game_start (0x11157c), game_stop (0x128a38) and the recovery run (0xe5884). profile_instance_start/stop never take it. GAME_RUNNING and GAME_OPERATION_CANCELLED do not occur in the start path (GAME_RUNNING exists only in the proxy-repair code at 0xd47442).

game_start (not used by the Home UI): profile resolver -> try-acquire op flag -> persist game_desired_running=true + memory flag + recovery observation reset + log 'game lifecycle start requested' -> find tracked game (0x41b451); present = success without launching; else kill LastWarLauncher/Updater/Sync (0x41e613), re-find, terminate stray game (0x41e543), launch; any failure releases the flag and persists game_desired_running=false.

differences: order is closed(GAME_OPERATION_CANCELLED) -> profile replacement (GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS) -> GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND -> phase starting/stopping (GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS) -> gamePid (GAME_RUNNING) -> UNMANAGED_GAME_RUNNING; original uses GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND -> PROFILE_ALREADY_RUNNING -> UNMANAGED_GAME_RUNNING and has none of the three clone codes
clone.fix: after the GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND check replace lines 683-687 by one check: if an instance record exists (instanceId != null) and it is not (phase=='error' && gamePid==null) throw PROFILE_ALREADY_RUNNING (code==message); keep the internal single-flight guard but surface it as PROFILE_ALREADY_RUNNING; map closed/profile-replacement waits to the same code or serialise them internally instead of GAME_OPERATION_*.

unknowns: Meaning of the reserve predicate flag byte ([entry-0x18]) is inferred (pid-less error record).
STATE_UNAVAILABLE ordering relative to INVALID_REQUEST for non-object payloads: INVALID_REQUEST is raised first (0x207684).

6.title: profile_instance_status record and connectionState classifier

facts.fact: Handler needs Object+String profileId else INVALID_REQUEST (NOT PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED in 0.3.17); then instance lookup 0x241836, runtime lookup 0x24156e (PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE). Record fields: profileId, instanceId, phase, pid, startedAt, lastError, identityConfirmed, leaseRequired + connectionState, bridgeConnected, lastHeartbeatAt, leaseActive (the last four keys are assembled from immediates, which is why a string search misses them).

connectionState: lastError!=null -> 'error'; phase 'starting' -> 'starting'; 'recovering' -> 'recovering'; 'awaitingIdentity' -> 'awaitingLogin'; otherwise leaseRequired && leaseStatus=='grace' && !leaseActive -> 'grace'; otherwise 'connected' iff bridgeConnected && heartbeatFresh && identityConfirmed (&& leaseActive when leaseRequired), else 'reconnecting'. Instance phases seen: starting, awaitingIdentity, running, recovering, error. No 'stopped'/'maintenance'/'offline' is produced; absence of an instance is a null result (carried from 0.3.1, structure matches).
UI connection labels: offline, starting, recovering, awaitingLogin, connected, reconnecting, grace, locked, error (profile.connection.*); no 'maintenance'.

differences: field set, null on no instance and the classifier table match the 0.3.17 bytes (single-profile, leaseRequired=false)

CreateInstanceStatus is a clone-only 5-field shape (phase 'stopped', connectionState 'offline'/'maintenance', error 'UNMANAGED_GAME_RUNNING'/'BRIDGE_DISCONNECTED'/'SERVER_MAINTENANCE') with no original counterpart; CurrentConnectionState can return 'maintenance', which has no profile.connection.maintenance label
clone.fix: keep it internal-only (diagnostics/Overview events); do not return it from any UI-visible command; map 'maintenance' to the original states ('reconnecting'/'error') before it reaches the UI.

unknowns: Null serialization of the none-case in 0.3.17 was matched structurally (poll return path not byte-traced).
Multi-profile lease fields remain protected-service dependent.

7.title: GameDesiredRunning persistence

facts.fact: Persisted: config.json key game_desired_running (bool). Written on every transition (0x2ceb43; STATE_UNAVAILABLE / INVALID_CONFIG 'bridge config must be an object' on failure). Read at runtime-context construction (0x41be3c, callers 0x21d66b and 0x29f4b4): missing/non-bool = false, stored in ctx+0x124; ctx+0x125 (op flag)=0, ctx+0x126 (monitor armed)=1.

Set true: game_start, launch finalize 0x23fac5 (with tracked pid), reconcile adoption (0x2a0cb7). Cleared: profile_instance_stop (0x199e30), launch rollback helper 0x1d4468, 0xe6f71, 0x16e139, 0x23c486, 0x41ca7d callers. It is a separate gate from auto_force_update_reload; the monitor tick additionally needs a tracked pid (ctx+0x120), so a persisted true alone does not relaunch after an app restart.

differences: persisting GameDesiredRunning matches the original; SetDesiredRunning(false) additionally calls NotifyAutomationChanged(false) which is a no-op here (original does not touch automation on clear)
clone.fix: none; do not make it memory-only.

unknowns: Exact clear sites 0xe6f71/0x16e139/0x23c486 not individually named.

8.title: Locale: Home error codes in the original frontend (index-BVfnK1wp.js tables Mr/Nr/Pr, en/ja)

facts.fact: Lookup: codes = error.code plus every [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,} token of the message (dedup, reversed); try error.<C>, auth.error.<C>, update.error.<C>; first translated hit wins; otherwise t('common.actionFailed') = en 'The action could not be completed.' / ja 操作を完了できませんでした。

Localized in the original (key error.<CODE>; en text): LAUNCH_FAILED 'The game could not be started.'; GAME_CLOSE_TIMEOUT 'Closing the game timed out.'; UNMANAGED_GAME_RUNNING 'Close the game started outside this application first.' (all 9 languages incl. ja). NOT localized in the original (fall back to common.actionFailed): INSTANCE_NOT_OWNED, RECOVERY_RECORD_INVALID, RECOVERY_PROCESS_MISMATCH, RECOVERY_RECORD_NOT_FOUND, STATE_UNAVAILABLE, GAME_REPAIR_REQUIRED, GAME_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS, GAME_OPERATION_CANCELLED, BRIDGE_DISCONNECTED, GAME_CLOSE_FAILED. Also not localized: PROFILE_LOCKED, PROFILE_ID_REQUIRED, PROFILE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_PROFILE_ID, INSTANCE_MISMATCH, INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND. INVALID_REQUEST is localized only via auth.error ('Check the information you entered.'). Localized and relevant: GAME_ROOT_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_GAME_ROOT, GAME_RUNNING, PROFILE_ALREADY_RUNNING, PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, GAME_DISCONNECTED, BRIDGE_START_TIMEOUT, INVALID_PROFILE_NOTE, INVALID_PROFILE_ORDER, PROFILE_LIMIT_REACHED.

The clone error.* block is identical to the original Mr table (101 keys, 0 text diffs, en+ja) and implements the same three-namespace lookup with the same common.actionFailed fallback (HomePage.jsx:58-64, ProfileSidebar.jsx:38-43). profile.connection.* keys equal the original Jr map; the clone has no profile.connection.maintenance (neither does the original).

differences: 10 clone-only codes correctly have no key: the original UI shows the generic message for them too
clone.fix: none; do not add keys. To change user-visible text for these cases the host must emit an original localized code instead (see items 1, 5).
